name: ravencreek
description: RPG multiplayer de sobrevivência zumbi com visual novel — Raven Creek

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npx --prefix client tsc -b client
